top_choice_rationale: P004 is a single coherent achievement in which a new classification principle (the Z2 invariant and the quantum spin Hall effect) was predicted by Kane and Mele and confirmed quantitatively in HgTe quantum wells by Molenkamp's group, with 15-20 years of independent confirmation. The 2016 prize did not cover time-reversal-invariant insulators, and the citation is limited to the prediction and the HgTe observation, so the omission of Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang is a real but tolerable attribution cost. P001 (optical lattice clock alone) is a close second with cleaner attribution but is a gain in what can be measured, not a new principle. P003 is not yet mature given the open pairing mechanism and the Cao, Fatemi and Dean credit gap. P002 pairs the clock with a one-name IceCube credit for Halzen, which I consider indefensible for a collaboration of hundreds. No award ranks last because several mature, defensible achievements are available.
